_comment: Hand-edited INPUT: the sites, which physical tree (1-14) stands in which sequence slot (1-6), and each tree's 12V run from the site box in metres. "router": "indoors" means the site router is on its own adapter (not the site PSU); default is on the site PSU. "psu" names a PSU already in hand; otherwise the smallest LRS that carries the site is chosen. DEFAULTS until Rob confirms (23 Oct 2026): 6/4/2/2 trees, every run 5m. Slots must start at 1 and run without gaps; tree IDs are used once across all sites. "network" overrides the default (192.168.8.x, tree NN at .100+NN, router .1, player .20, static IP set in WLED): prefix, tree_base, gateway, player, static (false = trees stay on DHCP and the router reserves their addresses).

network._note: Rob's home network, extended by the Cudy (Rob, 11 Nov 2026); DHCP reservations on the Zyxel OpenWrt at 192.168.0.3
